Best simple pedometer app ever!. This app is really nice looking on the screen and best of all IT UPDATES YOUR STEP COUNT EVERY FIVE SECONDS! Every five seconds you get an update of how many steps you've take since the last five second update!!! So basically, every time I take out my phone to see how many steps I've taken, I only have to wait five seconds to see my progress. With Apple's own health app, every time I take out my phone to get an update, I just stare at it and there's no update forever and ever! The other free pedometer apps I looked at also did not give updates with any useful frequency approaching on demand step count information. 

The only drawback is that you can't set the goal, which is set at 10,000 steps per day, but for a free app, with no ads, and no in-app purchases who can complain?!?! I do think this developer has an app that probably allows you to set a goal. Given their generosity, creating such a simple and functional pedometer app, I think eventually I'll probably buy their bells and whistles app at some point in the future, if anything, just to say, thanks!
